title: Threads
description: The threads this review left on the pull request before, in the one shape every host is folded into: where each sits, what it says, and whether it is open, resolved by the author, or resolved by someone else

Thread.description: One thread of ours on lines of the pull request

ThreadId.description: The thread, by the identifier its host gave it; the host's adapter is the only reader

ThreadState.description: open: still to be answered; resolved-by-author: the author marked it done, so its lines are probed again; resolved: someone else closed it, so it is left alone

ThreadBody.description: The first comment of the thread, which names the principle it cites

threads.body: A failing command passes as success breaks [Fail fast](https://thruput.se/agents/#fail-fast)
